scene: a Bia Saigon lager can beside a tumbler part-poured from it, on a bar counter
dedup_note: can + glass poured from it -> 1 alcohol serving
notes: The bottle-and-glass rule with a can instead of a bottle, and the only version of that mechanic in this batch the scorer can actually gate: the can and the glass hold the SAME drink, so the answer is one alcohol serving, not two. Portion is what was poured; the can is the container. If the rule was written against the word 'bottle' it will not fire here.
